# Mandate SDKs (generated by APIMatic)

`typescript/` and `python/` are generated from Mandate's OpenAPI document by the [APIMatic](https://www.apimatic.io) Platform API — do not edit them by hand. Regenerate (validate → import in place → generate → download → unpack, plus the docs portal in `public/docs-portal/`):

```sh
npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/sponsors/apimatic-generate.ts --portal
```

The same zips are served by the app at `/sdks` (`public/sdks/*.zip`). Each method is one bank tool, grouped like the Postman folders; authenticate with the `api_key` from `register_agent` as the bearer token.

- TypeScript: `npm install && npm run build`, then `new StartHereApi(new Client({ bearerAuthCredentials: { accessToken } })).getBankGuide({})`.
- Python: `pip install ./python`, then `MandatebankapiClient(bearer_auth_credentials=BearerAuthCredentials(access_token=...)).start_here.get_bank_guide({})`.

Both were smoke-tested against production (`get_bank_guide` → `200 OK`). Last run: `docs/sponsors/apimatic/last-run.json`.
